# QR Code generator library (C++)

Makes the QR code with which a student couples the practice book app (teacher's Qupil,
student's page; docs/student-app.md).

- Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator (commit 9a217d4, 2026-11-03),
  files `cpp/qrcodegen.hpp` and `cpp/qrcodegen.cpp`, unchanged
- Licence: MIT (see `LICENSE.md`), compatible with Qupil's GPL
